Dialogue: ふふ…
総長はどこへ…？
このあたりのはずだ…！
ちょちょいのちょいだぜ！

ボンクラ貴族にゃ
負けねぇ！

あんまり遠くには
行ってないよな…？

イッセにい
見つけてくれるかな？

喋ったら
すぐ見つかっちゃいますよ

オブリビオンのみんなにも
見せてみたいです

し、障壁の外は…
刺激的ですね…
さァ、楽しい饗宴だゾー！
ヒヒ…この扉の先には…
遊びまショー！
バァ～！

落ちたラもう
戻ってこられないヨォ…
ガタガタ！ガタガタ！
ギシギシ…ヒヒヒ…

ヨってらっしゃイ！
ミてらっしゃ～イ！
クルル…ニャーン…
ニャニャン…？
Suit up and head to the Core Shroud summit!
This way back to the lower level!
Return to your mechs over here!
Look sharp! It won't be long until the next project!

Who's the perfect warrior, who's our man?♪
Gaaadaaalar!♪
More beast than beauty, the ferocious Mihli!♪
We've nothing to fear so long as Serpent General Gadalar is here!
Serpent General Gadalar is gone! What do we do!?
W-Would you like to be one of my t-test subjects?
I hope my brother's all right...
I pray we have the numbers for this...
The day is ours thanks to those adventurers!
Things are about to take an interesting turn...
Don't get complacent, folks!
All contributors in the field, evacuate immediately!
Microbial activity is causing widespread malfunctions!
Red alert! Volunteers needed for critical duties!
We need those fungi gone, and fast!
To think the floracane would have such an effect on the Loporrits...
The microbes have them hopping about in a daze!
Thank you to all contributors!
The situation is now under control. Leave the rest to initiative command.
Auroral flare patterns detected!
We're detecting increased auroral activity!
Floracane incoming!
Floracane incoming!
It always plays havoc with the vegetation...
So the flares quicken plant growth...
We believe it to be a mechanism for eliminating foreign matter and preserving the natural environment.
I won't deny it's a beautiful sight. I just wish it didn't mess with our instruments...

Mission successful!
Let's pack it up, people!
The red alert is now lifted!
Dismissed! We'll handle the rest.
Just a little more mess to clean up...
Deposit your supplies here!
Destroy the Oizys plants─and nothing else!

Head in deeper.
We've got this area covered.
Flamethrowers are no good past this point...
Happy harvesting, but watch out for thorns!

Pretty, isn't it?
Let's see what secrets the water holds!
What's so different about this pond...?
If we can determine the source of this glow...
Fungi fighters, over here! We're in dire need of supplies!
This shouldn't take too long...hopefully.
We're going to need more firepower for this...
Drop off your harvest here, please! Drill components are also welcomed!
This should be the right spot!
Some replacement parts would be helpful right about now...
Any fruit above ground can be harvested as is!
Roader repair team, this way! Materials urgently required!
The circuit is fried to a crisp.
We need additional supplies if we're to finish these repairs!
Hehe, the drop-off point is...is right heeere!
We need something to snap them out of it, and quickly!
Look at our new dance! Wheee!
Lop Hop till you lop drop! Hehe!
Hahaha! More! More!!!
Ahaha, so much fun! But...what was I...?
Urp...I feel...sick...
Oh dear... Are you okay?
What's got into them?
Whatever it is, we should probably stop them. Cute as it is.
Drone repair teams, be wary of electrical malfunctions!
Hmm... This calls for spare parts─and plenty of 'em!
I'll start stacking the recovered drones over here.
Look lively! We need plenty of spores and specimens.
Leave the spore collection to us!
Make sure to gather specimens from the smaller clusters!
No shortage of specimens out here!
Wh-What was I...? What happened to us?
\\<pant> That was...so much...fun...!
Phew...much better. Now, where was I?
La la la!♪ We're just getting started!
I have to get it together! Back to work!
I can still see the carrots dancing when I close my eyes...
Here I go!♪
La la, la la la!♪
Just...five more minutes...
Lemme tell you a little something about living in the new age...
My, as expected!

星芒マーケットへ
ようこそー！
Reminds me of the forests back home.
How much is due with the next shipment?
I'll take a quick look.
Might be worth checking our current supply levels too.
I'll never tire of this view.
Imagine what we could achieve with a second starship!
More frequent shipments, for one.
They better be sending us some tasty treats!
These are the people who invented Archon loaf─don't get your hopes up...
Tap-tap-tap, tappy-tap-tap～♪
Any news about those upgrades I requested?
Last I heard, work was well underway!
'Bout time to put in a fresh order, I reckon.
Time to take you for a spin...
We're in the final stretch now.
Passed the airborne tests with flying colors!
So I see. Looks like you're cleared for launch.
These suits could really use a speed boost.
Forget speed, I want more features!
You'd both be better off improving your technique...
I heard we're finally generating an energy surplus.
About damned time.
We need to secure the equipment against floracanes.
I'm surprised we've had such few energy woes here.
Oizys was a real nightmare on that front...
Been a while since I've seen such stable readouts, at any rate.
Let's see what the traffic is like today.
I wish you'd at least try and limit your screen time...
This star is nothing like Oizys.
I can scarcely imagine what it's like outside the base.
Our first priority should be to understand the local climate.
Mysterious towers! How fascinating!
Can we get closer somehow?
New information should arrive in short order.
This time we must keep careful records.
First, we must fill our stomachs!
Regular rest is recommended!
Does this one have the vicarious vacationer program installed?
The air here is so fresh and pure! I can't get enough of it.
Apparently a support request's come in from the Sprouting Towerling!
I can head there immediately, but are you sure?
I'll check if there've been any updates.
Think we'll ever reach that towering structure?
I know we will!
The soil here is such an intriguing color.
Doesn't look any different to me...
And now, a small break!
Break! Break!
My knees hurt...
Say, do you have a moment?
M-Mumukko!? Give me just a second...
This star's civilization was highly advanced...
But where do you suppose the Voyagers went?
There's no concrete proof they went extinct, at least.
Everything we need is here on base!
We have the initiative's flawless planning to thank for that.
This is bound for the habitation module, I take it?
We've linked the tower and the base─but will it be enough?
Would that we could further optimize our analysis...
The sheer volume of data would likely pose an issue.
Hah! I'm surprised to see you with free time, Mumukko.
Mmmhm. Still waiting on your survey report, by the by.
Y-Yes, ma'am! I'll get right on it, ma'am!
Daily stretches keep the body limber!
They help me sleep easier!
I'm just here for the post-stretch carrots!
The tower team hasn't taken a single break...
Understood! Proper breaks are required!
And proper sleep, also required!
This'll make for fine footage.
N-No... No more Archon loaf... \\<snore>
...And then a floracane just stirred up out of nowhere!
Ooh! It must've been quite the sight!
Apparently, Namingway has had another stroke of inspiration...
This carrot jam is phenomenal!
I honestly don't know how I ever lived without it.
How's that new tablet of yours?
Er... Having a little trouble finding it, in truth...
I told you to turn the tracking feature on!
What an enchanting glow!
Do you suppose the whole star looked like this?
Roots─healthy and happy!
Aether currents─nice and sparkly!
So, that beam of light...
We're taking daily readings of its energy levels.
Might need to survey this isle's soil, too.
Time to put this thing through its paces!
What was the tower for, I wonder?
It's like the aether has dried up...
Let's hope the formula being researched can help.
What a lackluster stream. Maybe the battery isn't working properly?
Could be a clogged nozzle.
Oh yeah! Soak it all up!
This'll make you right as rain!
Don't miss an ilm! Use every last drop if need be!
What a dense thicket...
There could be important urban functions behind all that.
Reckon those new logging machines will be up to the task?
The dense growth must be due to highly concentrated aether.
Those trees won't know what hit 'em!
This should be more than enough.
Clang! Clang! With my cosmic hammer!♪
We'll punch right through this!
This tower seems somehow different.
It's completely overgrown with vines.
These energy readings are on a different scale!
I wonder what role each tower played.
It's responding to the indicolite...
How large should the clusters be?
Whatever size is easiest for you to carry.
Excavate carefully, now!
Gah, just how hard is this material!?
My drill will pierce you yet!
Perhaps the aquatic flora are to thank for these limpid waters...
Concerning the distribution of indicolite...
Just let me know if you have any work that requires heavy lifting.
All appears in order...
It's completely blocked off. Any ideas?
I would like to see what lies beyond.
Have care─these are relics left by the Voyagers!
I wonder, what lies over there?
To manipulate the growth of trees thus...the Voyagers were something else.
Let's give it our all, old friend!
With how dark it is, we must survey the area carefully.
We're moving at a good pace. Excellent.
I'll drill out a big chunk! Oh yes I will!
Bad news, friend. The thing's overheated.
Nooo, not my blessed drill!
Put your backs into it! For science!
\\<blip> \\<bloop>
It seems this towerling is connected to the one above.
...And then, my drill pierced the heavens!
Ummm...okay? Look, just don't poke any holes into the ruins.
We must examine this area thoroughly.
Hmm. The relationship between the towers...
Once this sector is restored...
Look, these would be a perfect fit for us!
I'm not so sure... I'm at least a few ilms taller!
Shift it to one of the outer bays, please!
Haha! It's my time to shine!
Ain't stoppin' until my battery pack runs flat!
Oh, sweet carrots! You never fail to disappoint.
I've never seen so much data...
This next phase is critical. Keep at it!
Hrrraaagh!
We ought to open new routes to other structures, too.
The work never ends...
It goes on and on... This city must've been truly vast.
It bears a striking resemblance to the star itself...
Maybe it's all supposed to represent their vision of the cosmos?
Behold, Auxesia!
This brand-new scenery stirs that old impulse...I simply must take pictures!
For our health and safety, we must warm up our bodies!
One two, one two!
Three four, three four!
Now to double-check the schedule.
Recordkeeping is an essential part of research.
Come on! Here we go!
Does the carrot jam tickle your fancy?
I could eat these until the end of time.
This star is unlike any we've ever seen.
I've never tasted bread quite like this!
Squeaky clean and awaiting orders.
A clean base is a happy base!
I can't wait to see what takes shape!
If a picture is worth a thousand words, I'm writing an epic!
That's it, everyone! Keep at it!
Wait, are we missing...? Not again!
Yessir!
Things are progressing smoothly. Keep up the pace, everyone!
Less haste, more speed!
A finish to satisfy even the most exacting perfectionist─me.
I have a real eye for detail, you know.
And then this goes here...
Carefully...carefully!
This is what I trained for!
This way!
Over here!
The habitation module...
Say cheese!
Is finished!
Hooray!
All according to schedule thus far...
It's our finest work yet. The team has truly grown.
Cheese!
Smile, everyone!
We're real nomads of the stars, aren't we?
I'm certainly an expert at packing my bags!
Here's to another job well done, partner.
How thrilling!
Keep it up, everyone! We're almost there!
Remember: safety first!
I always say─it's all in the details!
Yes, yes! It's all coming together!
Stand back and watch.
Concentrate...concentrate!
This calls for absolute precision and control!
Our best work yet!
Hold still, everyone!
Mission complete!
Make me look fierce, all right?
Say trees!
Smooth sailing so far, eh?
I wonder what fresh trouble awaits us here...
No one speak to me before I've had my carrot juice.
Wait, the meals here are actually...edible?
Good riddance to that gaol food they served before!
Gods, I can't believe I'm crying over jam...
Nobody likes maintenance, but it's important!
If nothing else, we should examine the battery.
After that long journey, certainly.
Let there be light!
Better make sure we're on schedule.
Raaargh!
This mudstone is tough stuff!
But in a powersuit...
I am UNSTOPPABLE!
Heh heh! Work smarter, not harder.
Behold, the Timberlodge!
Bigger and better than ever!
Looks like we're all stocked up.
Now we can relax a while!
Suppose now's as good a time as any for maintenance.
Let's see here... Everything looks fine.
Perhaps a test flight just to be sure.
Alright, off you go!
That's a good...er, drone.
We might have more food supplies now, but nothing beats this.
It's your favorite, isn't it?
Just try to leave some for the rest of us.
Good, the formula appears unaffected.
Battery supply is sufficient.
Never hurts to check your tools before using them.
Time for me and my partner here to seek new frontiers.
Where are you!?
Oh come on, let's do this together!
Just a little more.
Good, looks properly sealed.
The cosmoport...
Has been upgraded!
It was a tall order, but I think we managed to maintain the city's stylistic harmony.
All thanks to judicious use of materials.
This star makes me feel as though I'm back in Labyrinthos.
Exactly! It's quite easy to get used to a place like this.
Hells, even the Archon loaf's the same...
Say, “Mech hangar upgrade!”
Mech hangar upgraaade!
We've got so many mechs now, I can barely keep track!
The engineers really outdid themselves.
This dance is a celebration of interstellar discovery!♪
The conclusion to our investigation of the Voyagers' civilization fast approaches.
Assuming the core can be restored without issue, of course.
Nothing beats a hot meal!
How many times must I tell you to slow down?
A slice of bread with a thick layer of carrot jam is more than enough for me.
I wonder what we'll learn from the core once it's restored...
The Euhedron revealed a navigation chart...damned if I know what we'll discover this time.
Mission complete. Time to clean up.
Cleaning is one of my specialties!
Cleaning! Cleaning!
Our dance is a celebration of successful exploration!♪
Seems they were able to restore the core's functions.
I had every faith in Dylise and her team.
I guess our job here is done...
It certainly had its moments!

What do you mean, “done”?
There's a tonze of research left to do!
What will you do now?
I could return to school...but I have so much to learn here.
I'm usually more of a lone wolf...
We'll go with you!
Everyone, together!
Have you come to meet the interstellar dhalmel? They're lovely creatures.
Given their size, though, they can be quite dangerous. You mustn't touch, okay?
I'm afraid duty calls. But, while I'm gone...
How distinguished! How imposing! How...adorable!
I know! I won't touch, I give my word!
...But I didn't say I wouldn't ride it. Hehe!
I knew it, you rotten scoundrel!
Get your arse back down here!
You'll never take me alive! CHAAARGE!
Mrrrn!
For the last time...you cannot. Ride. The dhalmel!
...If you truly feel that way, we can register you for pilot training.
It's no easy feat, mind! But if you're that determined...
I-I'm sorry! I just...felt so alive on it, you know? So free!
Wait! I can do that? Really!?
Huzzah! I'll do it─I'll be the best pilot ever!
But I could get used to company. Mech's not much of a talker.
They still breathe─albeit faintly...
There's no fight left in them now.
Don't worry, I have my eye on them.
We need only close the fissure...
I'd wager the creature is not long for this world.
It's over...
Enuo's reign is at an end.
Stay behind me!
There's no end to them!
I have this flank covered!
Fear not, I shall protect thee.
That's a relief!
This is frightful!
Oh, Urianger!
No sign of any voidsent here!
Any contributors may come right this way!

Ah...ah...achoo!
This pollen is nasty stuff.
We'll have to get you a mask or something.
The Voyagers really did build some amazing things...
You can see the air getting cloudy. I don't like this one bit...
I'm here to help get things done! Again!
Handle the big ones with the mech! We'll deal with the rest!
If a plant could scream “I am very poisonous”...

Curse this wretched pollen.
Burn the growths! Burn them all!!!
Use the mech to cut down the growths directly!
We'll have this field cleared in no time!
The field scanners will expose any hidden growths!
Deposit your incinerated plant matter here!

Ah...ah...achoo─ow!
My poor nose...
My nostrils are on fire!
Th-This is nothing! Just a little poisonous pollen!
We'll use the field scanners to stun the growths!
Ground support, deposit your ash at the scanners!
Oh, those new ones look positively lethal!
Nice moves with that mech!
Well, that's cleared the air.
Another day, another mech op done!
\\<sniff> O blessed be my nasal passages! What bliss to breathe normally again!
Phew. Glad to have pilots like you around.
Without a doubt.
You think the Voyagers cultivated the plants around here?
So basically we're to...spray fertilizer?
All-new star, all-new adventures!
Witness me! I am the master of mech ops!
Hm, might need a refill soon...
Have to aim carefully if I don't want to waste this formula!
Gods, this stuff works fast!
Keep an eye out for air-dropped supplies!
We'll keep you apprised of supply drone drops!
We've requisitioned additional mech supply drops!
Resupply your sprayers at the formula tanks!
Replenish your stock of formula over here!
Step right this way for formula refills!
We'd never get the job done without mechs!
I could get used to this kind of work.
Hard to tell if we've helped the star or not...
Hopefully that's nudged nature in the right direction.
Bit of a scramble, but mission accomplished.
It's a bit like walking through a park. A big, abandoned park...
Perfect! Once you load that on, I've got more for you.
Erm... How many more, exactly?
Such strangely shaped flora...
Mmm...! The Faculty of Medicine's new jam is divine!
You can handle another one, right?
Only one way to find out!
